jobs.description_text: About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role The Kuala Lumpur hub stands as the technological epicenter for MoneyLion, where innovation meets velocity in the pursuit of disrupting traditional finance. Embrace the dynamism and challenges within our diverse collective of pioneers and disruptors. As a Senior Backend Engineer at MoneyLion, your expertise will be pivotal in architecting the backbone of our fintech solutions. Dive into our forward-thinking engineering brigade, dedicated to reshaping the fintech landscape. Your role involves crafting, implementing, and refining microservices and RESTful APIs, the vital cogs that enable seamless financial experiences across various platforms. In essence, a Senior Backend Engineer in MoneyLion is not just a coder but a multifaceted professional who plays a key role in shaping the technological direction and success of their team. Join us in this journey to empower consumer finance through cutting-edge technology and innovation. About MoneyLion MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. MoneyLion’s mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action. In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. People take control of their finances with our innovative financial products and marketplace - including our full-fledged suite of features to save, borrow, spend, and invest - seamlessly bringing together the best offers and content from MoneyLion and our 1,100+ Enterprise Partner network, together in one experience. MoneyLion’s enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Established in 2013, MoneyLion connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it. Key Responsibilities - Design and implement complex software solutions tailored to fintech needs. - Take on a leadership role in and mentor development teams, guiding project direction and architecture. - Ensure software complies with security standards and financial regulations. - Optimize application performance for scalability and user experience. - Uphold quality assurance through rigorous testing and code reviews. - Solve intricate technical challenges under tight deadlines. - Keep abreast of the latest fintech technologies and industry trends. - Facilitate collaboration across departments to align software with business objectives. - Provide operational support, troubleshooting, and system improvements. - Contribute to strategic planning with tech insights and innovation proposals. About You: - Experienced in Java, or any other OOP languages such as C#.NET, or PHP. - Experienced in any relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MSSQL. - Experienced in non-relational databases such as MongoDB, DocumentDB, or CosmosDB. - Experienced in web APIs of reasonable complexity. - Familiar with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. - You have a Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience - At least 4+ years of experience building and developing software would be preferred. Technology stack we use: Java, Spring Boot, Nodejs, ES6, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS. (Don’t worry if you don’t know all of them right now, because you don’t have to) What's Next... Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

jobs.description_text: About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion, where we measure anything and everything and rely on data to guide our decisions: both long-term strategies and day-to-day operations. Combine that backdrop with an incredible volume and sophistication of data and mix in MoneyLion’s voracious appetite for adopting paradigm-shifting technologies and you have the mission and mandate of the Data Engineering team. Now turbo-charged with a planetscale mandate as part of Gen Digital, we aim to leverage tried-and-true methodologies with game-changing technology to create a AI-native, scalable, extensible, and cost-effective data infrastructure across the Gen Digital enterprise and beyond. As a Data Engineer, you are a technical Individual Contributor (IC) figure within the team that will design, implement and optimize a Snowflake-centric architecture that will leverage many components of the modern data stack. You will be a trusted subject matter expert on dimensional data modeling, performant SQL query writing, infrastructure optimization, process automation and governance. You will be given the opportunity to leverage the latest and greatest AI tools and features, including Claude Code (Enterprise) and Snowflake’s Cortex Code, among many others. You will be responsible for designing and implementing an analytical environment using in-house and third-party tools, using Python and/or Java to automate data activities and enable efficient processing of data that is growing in both volume and complexity. You will design and implement complex data pipelines and data models for analytical consumption. You will write scalable and performant SQL queries running over billions of rows of data and design workflows aimed to ruthlessly streamline the governance of our complex layers of storage. You should have deep experience in designing and managing large datasets and pipelines to enable business use-cases. You should be an authority at designing, implementing and operating solutions that are scalable, stable and cost-efficient. Above all, you will be an authority on crafting thoughtful solutions that will empower absolutely everyone at Gen Digital towards an agentic AI-first analytics and development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities - Extensive expertise operating & optimizing a modern data warehousing solution (Snowflake preferred) from both performance and cost perspectives. - Expertise with Apache Kafka, real-time data processing, and event-driven architectures - Experience with Apache Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures, and modern table formats - Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, product managers, software engineers and other data engineers to develop, implement and validate deployed data solutions. - Build and maintain data pipelines from internal databases and SaaS applications - Implement better solutions for data governance at scale, encompassing lineage, discoverability, and regulatory compliance. - Advocate best practices, uphold the highest standards for code maintainability and performance, and constantly champion our team’s core values of psychological safety and building in public. - Lead the team in honing our ways of working, coaching and mentoring junior engineers, and managing senior stakeholders from external departments. About You - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related technical field - 1-4 years of hands-on data engineering experience in large-scale, high-volume environments - Expert-level proficiency in SQL optimization for multi-petabyte datasets and advanced Python programming - Experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and cost management at enterprise scale - Demonstrated expertise building Kimball dimensional data warehouses and star schema architectures, or equivalent experience with thoughtful, non-generic projects - Advanced experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and either DBT or SQLMesh for data transformations - Familiarity with AWS is a big plus - Experience in planning day to day tasks, knowing how and what to prioritise and overseeing their execution What's Next... After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process: 1. Online Preliminary Codility test 2. Recruiter Screening Call 3. Take-home Assessment 4. Take Home Discussion (Virtual) 5. Interview - Hiring Manager (Virtual or face-to-face), 1.5 hours

About the Role We are looking for a Manager to lead a team building and scaling machine learning and AI solutions that drive measurable business impact. This role is designed for someone who is passionate about applied machine learning, artificial intelligence, and using data-driven solutions to solve real-world problems. As a Manager, Machine Learning & AI, you will combine people leadership, technical direction, and cross-functional execution to bring machine learning and AI solutions from experimentation into production. Key Responsibilities - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing machine learning and AI team, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous learning. - Shape the technical direction of machine learning and AI initiatives aligned with business priorities and product goals. - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and platform teams to frame business problems and translate them into machine learning and AI solutions. - Guide projects from early exploration and experimentation through development, production, monitoring, and iteration. - Drive strong standards in experimentation, model evaluation, reliability, maintainability, monitoring, and governance across the team’s work. - Support the team in designing scalable machine learning systems, workflows, and development practices that improve long-term delivery velocity. - Provide technical guidance on architecture, trade-offs, and implementation strategy without becoming a bottleneck for the team. - Communicate technical concepts, risks, and opportunities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Research, evaluate, and guide the practical adoption of new machine learning and AI ideas, including modern methods such as LLM-based systems, where they can create meaningful business value. - Help build repeatable capabilities, frameworks, and ways of working that enable multiple machine learning efforts to succeed over time, not just individual one-off projects. About You - Demonstrated experience leading machine learning or AI initiatives from idea to production, with a track record of translating business problems into practical solutions. - Experience managing, mentoring, and developing technical team members. - Strong foundation in machine learning, experimentation, statistical thinking, and software engineering. - Good programming knowledge and strong hands-on familiarity with Python and SQL. - Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning systems in production. - Ability to frame business problems, prioritize effectively, and guide teams toward practical, high-impact solutions. - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Comfortable operating in fast-paced and ambiguous environments while balancing execution, technical quality, and team growth. - Experience working with modern machine learning frameworks and tooling, with the ability to evaluate and apply the right technologies for different use cases. - Familiarity with modern MLOps tooling and production workflows, including model monitoring, CI/CD, and lifecycle management. - Experience with cloud platforms and production infrastructure. - Exposure to natural language processing, search, recommendation systems, or modern GenAI / LLM application patterns is a plus. - Experience improving engineering standards, governance, and reusable internal capabilities across multiple machine learning projects. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Regional Public Affairs team leads high-impact projects that align commercial and regulatory goals. The team partners with business teams and public sector stakeholders to drive initiatives that leverage technology for societal impact. You will provide direct exposure to senior leaders and an opportunity to work across diverse business areas to drive strategy. Get to Know the Role You will sit at the intersection of policy research, data, and communications. You will focus on building the data and research-related systems and foundations that the wider Public Affairs teams can leverage, to generate and bring data-driven evidence and insights to government as part of their broader policy advocacy campaigns. . In support of this, your role will also involve translating research and data into compelling, government-ready insights and narratives that advance Grab's policy interests and positions. You will report to the Head, Regional Public Affairs (Policy) and work across teams to generate, systemize and turn complex information into credible evidence that helps governments better understand Grab's role and impact on the economies and societies in which we operate. This is a unique opportunity to shape how data and research influence policy conversations across the region. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Establish and steward a Public Affairs data view across Grab's data environment, defining the data, metrics, and metadata required to support policy objectives. Align internal stakeholders on shared definitions for policy-relevant measures, such as earnings, economic contribution, livelihoods, and platform activity. Build and maintain a trusted bank of validated statistics and evidence for government engagement, including clear processes for external data sharing and Legal review. Identify evidence gaps, define scope of research and manage research projects to deliver high quality, rigourous, and relevant quantitative and qualitative work that addresses these gaps. Translate complex research and data into concise reports, policy briefs, infographics, presentations, and narratives tailored to government priorities. Partner closely across functions at Grab - e.g. with Country Public Affairs, business, data analytics, marketplace economics, finance technology teams, and also with external parties e.g. research institutions, think-tanks to deliver projects in line with the above objectives• Lead evidence work across four Public Affairs priorities: demonstrating Grab's contribution, anticipating policy developments, shaping emerging policy discussions, and quantifying the impact of regulation on Grab and its stakeholders. Use generative AI and emerging tools to accelerate research synthesis, data analysis, ideation, and content development, applying appropriate human review and quality controls. What Essential Skills You Will Need At least 6 years of experience in public policy, public affairs, policy research / economics, economic or social impact, strategic insights, data analytics, or a related field. Frame and interpret quantitative and qualitative research, assess methodological quality, and translate findings into practical recommendations and insights that support business or policy decisions. Experience producing government-facing or executive-level reports, policy briefs, presentations, infographics, or similar evidence-based communications. Experience successfully managing cross-functional projects involving teams such as Analytics, Finance, Legal, Technology, or external research partners. Explain complex data and policy issues clearly to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas. Good to Have Experience working with governments, regulators, public policy institutions, think tanks, or research organisations. Experience in Southeast Asian markets or in sectors such as the platform economy, mobility, deliveries, digital financial services, or artificial intelligence. Familiarity with SQL, business intelligence tools, data visualisation, or modern data warehouse environments. A degree in economics, public policy, social sciences, statistics, communications, or a related discipline. Life at Grab We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer: We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance. With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations. Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges. Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours What We Stand For at Grab We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

jobs.description_text: The Role As our Lead Specialist for Data Scientist (Analytics), you will be the strategic voice behind our product development, turning complex data into relevant experiments that shape the bank's future. This isn't just an analytics role; it's an opportunity to lead the data lifecycle, pioneer Generative AI programs, and directly influence how we build products at GXBank. What You'll Do: Partner with product, design, and engineering teams to obtain insights, design experiments, and lead important product decisions. Support strategic plans with data insights, performing deep-dives into user behavior, segmented views and product efficacy. Provide tailored analysis for specific products and strategies, define critical business and product metrics, and make regular recommendations for continuous improvements. Design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments, including layout optimisation, UI/UX efficacy, algorithm effectiveness, and API performance. Analyse clickstream and transactional data to uncover insights on user behaviour and guide product metrics. You will manage instrumentation for all feature releases within assigned tech families within the bank. Develop self-serve solutions for partners that are scalable and automated to handle a product environment. Guide plans involving Large Language Models or Generative Artificial Intelligence Who We Are Looking For: Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields. Minimum 5 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, preferably in a Bank or Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company. Proficient in writing advanced SQL queries, Python and querying large relational databases. Skilled in data visualisation platforms like Tableau or HTML to present findings. Experience translating data insights into relevant recommendations for non-technical and senior team members. Experience designing A/B tests and product experiments, with knowledge of hypothesis testing and the basic principles of Design of Experiments (DoE). jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The Fulfilment Tech Family is at the heart of helping Grab outserve our consumers and partners in different businesses and marketplaces across Southeast Asia. Our mission is to offer the best marketplace platform capabilities, products and experiences to our driver partners as to increase adoption and engagement of our services. We improve driver partner opportunities and efficiency to fulfil consumer orders without fail, rain or shine. Get to Know the Role You will be within the Fulfilment tech family, responsible for platform's effectiveness and reliability through optimizations across supply planning, dispatch strategy, pricing, driver experiences and efficiency. The team extracts data and experiment insights that directly help improve our models & develop technical products and programs, setting new benchmarks for excellence. Reporting to Senior Analytics Manager, you'll collaborate across departments (Product, Business, Engineering, Design, and Data Science) to transform data into dynamic solutions. Your insights will directly help develop groundbreaking products and programs, setting new benchmarks for excellence. This isn't just any role; it's a chance to affect millions of lives every day. You will work onsite at our office in Petaling Jaya. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform You will transform requirements into concise data requirements, identify trends, spot anomalies, build insights through dashboards and presentations to create comprehensive views for decision-making. You will develop data pipelines and custom data science models to solve identified problems. You will create data-driven hypotheses and collaborate with product and engineering teams to design experiments that inform important product decisions. You will design data specifications for new products, ensuring accurate data collection. You will launch A/B and timeslice experiments, analyse results, and provide relevant recommendations. You will conduct targeted analysis for specific products and operations, to find new business/product opportunities, define critical business metrics, and track them rigorously. You will work with partners to scope problems and enhance internal processes through automation. You will build existing AI tools and capabilities to enhance overall productivity for the Analytics function What Essential Skills You Will Need You have 2 or more years in data-related or quantitative fields You are fluent in SQL, Python, R, or other scripting/programming languages. Your comfort with very large datasets and complex Extract, Transform, and Load processes sets you apart. Statistical knowledge: You have hands-on experience running and analysing controlled experiments, turning data into relevant insights. You can help narrow down multiple options into the best approach, and take ownership of open-ended ambiguous business problems. Propose novel solutions that go beyond common practice You have skills in designing experiments, data visualisation and storytelling. You can create intuitive and impactful dashboards using PowerBI or Tableau. You can guide teams to advise senior partners. jobs.description_text: Get to Know the Team The People Science team, within Grab's Office of Organisational Capabilities, turns people data, research, and AI into better organisational decisions. We are building a user-centric intelligence capability that helps Grabbers, managers, People teams, and business leaders understand what is happening, identify what matters, and take effective action. Get to Know the Role As Research Scientist, People Analytics you will apply strategic consulting, applied research, and structured problem-solving to complex people and organisational challenges. You will build AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, develop an organisational listening engine that turns signals into action, and advise People and business leaders on real problems. This is a hands-on role requiring research rigour, analytical judgement, and user-centric product thinking. You will report to the Head, People Science. Work arrangement: 5-day onsite. The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Build an organisational listening and action engine using employee listening, workforce, behavioural, and operational data to identify signals, diagnose root causes, and guide action. Build user-centric AI systems and agents that automate People Science workflows, from data discovery and analysis to hypothesis testing, programme evaluation, insight generation, and recommendations. Conduct applied organisational research using qualitative and quantitative methods, including surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches. Design hypotheses and evaluate People programmes or interventions using appropriate research, experimental, or quasi-experimental methods. Act as a strategic advisor to People and business leaders by framing ambiguous problems, conducting analysis, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions. Democratise people data through accessible AI agents, self-service tools, and data products that help non-technical users make better decisions. What Essential Skills You Will Need 5 - 12 years of experience in strategic consulting, applied research, organisational research, decision science, analytics, or a related field, with hands-on end-to-end problem solving. Experience advising senior stakeholders by defining ambiguous problems, diagnosing root causes, evaluating options, and translating evidence into practical decisions. Strong applied research capability across qualitative and quantitative methods, including research design, hypothesis development, surveys, interviews, experiments, and mixed-method approaches. Practical knowledge of programme evaluation, experimental design, causal or quasi-experimental analysis, and the ability to interpret evidence and its limitations. Experience synthesise data, research findings, and user perspectives into clear recommendations. Working proficiency in at least one analytical language, such as SQL, Python, or R, with the ability to conduct and interpret analysis. Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to improve research, analysis, workflows, and decision support, with an understanding of responsible AI, privacy, and bias considerations. Good To Have Experience in People Analytics, organisational psychology, behavioural science, workforce strategy, or social research. Experience building or prototyping AI systems, AI agents, LLM-enabled workflows, or analytical automation. Experience with employee listening, behavioural interventions, productivity measurement, programme implementation, or organisational change.
